request: Find a basically equivalent or better capacitor without ordering a reel of 900.
status: Applied to BOM, schematic and PCB; startup sensitivity screen completed. Hardware qualification remains open.

original.case: F80, 6.3 mm diameter x 7.7 mm nominal height
original.ordering_note: The user reported that the actual JLCPCB preorder requires 900, superseding the earlier public-page minimum of 37 as the usable order quantity.

recommended_candidate.configuration: Parallel across SLOT_3V3 and GND, both on top

bank_calculation.ripple_note: 7.8 A is the sum of two 3.9 A ratings with equal sharing. It is not an independently guaranteed bank rating. Keep paths short and similar; account for ESR/capacitance tolerance and temperature when qualifying ripple current.

footprint.basis: Chemi-Con land-pattern table lists F61 and F80 together: 1.9 mm gap, two 3.5 x 1.6 mm pads. PXF datasheet page 1 confirms F61 is 6.3 x 5.8 mm with the same 6.6 x 6.6 mm base.
footprint.implementation: Shared F61/F80 land geometry implemented for both 330 uF components. New C136 is on top at (47.05,118) mm. Native placement, physical power/ground connectivity and Gerber shorts checks pass. Full routed JLCPCB DRC reports no errors.

recommended_candidate.price_note: Public single-unit price, before assembly fees, attrition, tax and shipping.

search_scope: Live JLCPCB polymer capacitor category: In Stock, SMD, 560 uF and 6.3 V; seven listed candidates.
Live JLCPCB polymer capacitor category: In Stock, SMD, 680 uF and 6.3 V; three listed candidates.
Broader higher-voltage 680 uF and long-life category candidates were reviewed; this was not an exhaustive catalog export.
single_part_result: No verified stocked single-part replacement meeting all original capacitance, voltage, ESR, ripple and endurance requirements was found in the reviewed candidates.

not_recommended.reason: Keeps 560 uF / 6.3 V, F80 package and 15000 h endurance, but 22 mOhm ESR and 2.85 A ripple are materially worse than 8 mOhm / 5 A.

Manufacturer datasheet gives 13 mOhm ESR and 4.5 A ripple, and depicts radial leads with 2.5 mm pitch, despite JLCPCB listing SMD. Not a verified footprint-compatible substitute; 2000 h endurance is also below the original.
Catalog: 9 mOhm, 4.5 A, 2000 h at 105 C, 8 mm diameter. All four are worse or larger than the original target.

qualification_before_implementation: Choose and verify the second top-side footprint position, copper clearances and connection geometry.
Recheck startup/inrush and slot-switch SOA for the 18 percent increase in board bulk capacitance; include actual endpoint capacitance.
Recheck decoupling impedance and transient response with component tolerances and routing parasitics.
Treat the 15000 h rating as component endurance, not a guaranteed assembled-board service life.

implementation.routing: Extended SLOT_3V3 bulk branch on inner2. Three power and three GND full-stack via-in-pad contacts added at C136. Existing C135 lands, existing component placements and saved routes retained.

remaining_qualification: Measure output, MOSFET VDS and current during startup using the intended PSU and card; compare actual trajectories with temperature-appropriate SOA.
Check hot restart, repeated startup, shutdown and faults. No active current limiting is present.
